notes: Durations are ONNX Runtime kernel_time records (microsecond resolution). Session records (model_run, session_initialization) are listed but excluded from operation totals.
The profile does not record the ONNX Runtime version; this adapter is tested with 1.20.1.
Layer numbers are parsed from node names (e.g. "layers.3"), not reported by ONNX Runtime.

Activation summaries were computed from tensor values ONNX Runtime returned, for 40 kernel event(s). Only nodes whose output was exposed as a graph output have one; exposing outputs can change which kernels ONNX Runtime fuses and how long they take. Attention weights are not captured.
